name: Pyronema omphalodes
notes: A fire specialist and an ascomycete: extremely fast, first on fresh burns, and it loses to competitors once soil life returns. Reported (unchecked) to have a sequenced genome.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): one of the fastest fungi known on freshly burnt or steamed soil, covering a plate in a day or two

growth_unit.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): wide, fast, sparsely branched hyphae at the colony edge; guess

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
